description: Per-model cost rates the Stage 6 estimator reads to price a handoff (REQ-101). Two per-model shapes are supported: a size-scaled TOKEN model (price_in/out_per_mtok + input_tokens_per_char/input_base_tokens + output_tokens_per_school/output_base_tokens) OR a flat per_call_usd. `assumptions.escalation_rate` = the assumed fraction of reps whose voters disagree and invoke the judge. Authority: STAGE6_DISPATCH_DESIGN_2026-06.md §3C.
governance: This ships as a BOOTSTRAP and is SUPERSEDED by measurement: stage6_handoff/cost_benchmark.py fits per-model input/output token models on CURRENT clean reps and rewrites this file with provenance='measured'. The bootstrap values below are the project's own prior per-call measurements (EXTRACTION_BENCHMARK_FINDINGS Update 4) taken on OLD polluted inputs — real numbers, but FLAT (no size scaling) and not on clean data, hence provisional. escalation_rate is a conservative assumption (overestimate spend) pending the accuracy/agreement benchmark.

assumptions.escalation_rate_note: conservative placeholder; measured by the accuracy/agreement benchmark (deferred, §3C C.6)
assumptions.default_n_schools_note: school-count floor for output-token scaling when a rep carries no n_schools/n_times (only used on the measured token path; the bridge should populate a real count)
